start.lede: Paste text back and forth, live. What you paste arrives as you pasted it, line endings included.
start.privacy: Notes are encrypted in your browser before they are sent, so the server only ever holds them encrypted, in memory, never on disk. A session is deleted when someone ends it, when it expires, or shortly after everyone has left.
start.title: New session
start.hint: You get a random session name and password to send to the other person.
start.name: Your name

join.title: Join a session
join.hint: Use the session name and password you were sent, or open the link.

gone.title: This session has ended.
gone.lede: Someone ended it, everyone left, it expired, or the server restarted. Its notes are gone from the server.

room.emptyHint: Paste something below, or paste anywhere on this page.

rolled.notice: This session is at its maximum size: the oldest notes now make room for new ones.

invite.label: Send these to the other person
invite.hint: To be extra careful, send the link without the password, and the password over a different channel.

expiry.title: Change when this session is deleted
expiry.label: Delete everything in

clear.one: Clear the only note? It disappears for everyone in this session.
clear.other: Clear all {count} notes? They disappear for everyone in this session.

confirm.end: End this session? All notes are deleted from the server and the link stops working for everyone.

toast.nothingToClear: There are no notes to clear.

burn.title: Burn after reading
burn.waiting: Waiting for someone to read it.
burn.gone: This note was already opened or deleted.
burn.rolled: No longer available: the session made room for newer notes.
burn.forbidden: You sent this note, so you can't open it here.
burn.once: Shown once. Close it and it is gone.

compose.label: Note text
compose.placeholder: Paste or type here. Ctrl+Enter or Cmd+Enter sends.
compose.name: Your name

image.label: Image
image.dropHere: Drop images here to add them
image.unsupported: Only PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF images can be added.
image.unreadable: This image could not be read.
image.tooLarge: This image is too large to send, even compressed.
image.gifTooLarge: This GIF is too large to send. GIFs are not compressed, so their animation stays intact.
image.tooMany: You can add up to {count} images at a time.
image.previewNote: Low-resolution preview: the full image was sent before you joined.

error.BAD_REQUEST: The server could not handle this request.
error.NOT_FOUND: No session with that name and password.
error.LOCKED: Too many wrong attempts from your network. Try again later.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many new sessions from your network. Try again later.
error.TAKEN: That session name is already in use. Try again.
error.TOO_LARGE: This is too large to send.
error.SESSION_FULL: This session is full. Clear all notes to make room.
error.SERVER_FULL: The server is full right now. Try again later.
error.FORBIDDEN: You can't open a note you sent yourself.
error.METHOD: The server could not handle this request.
error.INSECURE: This page must be opened over HTTPS (or on localhost). Encryption isn't available on plain http.
error.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on the server. Try again.
error.CONNECTION: No connection to the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.BUSY: This session or server is busy right now. Trying again…
error.COPY_BLOCKED: Copy was blocked by the browser. Select the text and copy it yourself.
error.DECRYPT: This note could not be decrypted.
